options.hPacksb:
Plugins extend the Arnés; turn each one on or off here or in ≡ › Plugins.
Body, Cable and Ear come signed from the store and can't be edited.
A custom plugin adds your own commands from a folder: a package made at home or a cloned repository. Add a plugin › Choose folder… registers it, turned on.
✎ shows or hides its options: its name, version, folder, options menu and commands. What you change there stays a draft until Save applies it all at once (and restarts the Body if the plugin brings code); Cancel drops it. × takes it off the list, asking first, leaving the folder untouched.
The options menu opens what its author put in its folder (an .exe, a .bat, a .cmd or a page) or a web address, from ≡ › Plugins › its name › Options.
› options.exe · options.bat · options.html · http://127.0.0.1:7600
options.hCmdsb:
Each row is a command: the command line it uses and its help, which together make its line in the helper.
› /openemail · opens the inbox
Active: unchecked, the command doesn't run and its row turns gray, keeping its marks.
Helper: shows it in the helper, and the Arnés serves it to its AI.
Cable: serves it to Claude Code and Codex through the Harness Cable. It shows only when the Harness Cable is installed.
Permissions: when it asks for approval, with the levels of the permissions button. Bypass permissions never asks.
A command takes up to 100 characters and its help up to 80.
options.delM: It leaves the list with its commands and options. Its folder is not touched.
options.exists: That folder is already a plugin.
options.browser_off: The browser is set to None.
options.window_hidden: With a hidden window there is no browser to show.
options.no_view: 53ON's page is not answering: wait for it to load and try again.

ask.arnesb: The AI wants its hands and eyes in this window of the Arnés.
options.lAsk: Ask where to save each file
options.hMsgb:
Only the user ID entered here can write to the AI, and the AI replies only to that user.
To send a message to a specific section, start it with the section name in square brackets:
› [Sales] Check order 12
A reply to a message signed with [Name] goes to that section. A message without a name goes to the Destination.
options.hModeb:
Defines when the AI in the 53ON chat asks for approval before acting on this PC.
Manual: asks before every action.
Plan: only reads and proposes; it acts once the plan is approved.
Auto: asks only for risky actions.
Bypass permissions: never asks. For a trusted PC only.
ask.title: Confirm command
ask.screenb: The AI wants to see your whole screen. While it looks, its eyes show twice their size.
options.dStore: The cache only keeps copies: clearing it is safe. Clearing the data signs you out and removes what the web keeps on this computer; your memory, your files and your Arnés settings are not touched.
options.wiped: Data cleared. Sign in again with your account.
options.wipeM: You are signed out of 53ON and of the sites you signed in to here (Google, Facebook), and what the web keeps on this computer is removed: page preferences and local copies. Your account and what is on the server stay, and so do your memory, your files and your Arnés settings. This cannot be undone.
